metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) — Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: No standalone religious exemption form — Michigan law requires screening; refusal is documented in the medical record per MDHHS guidance. Parents may also request destruction of blood spots via MDHHS-5683 form.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Collect blood spots on MDHHS-supplied filter paper card; if parent objects, document refusal in medical record. If outside hospital, midwife can determine eligibility for free screening (call 517-335-1400).
metabolic_screening.declination_law: Michigan Public Health Code, Act 368 of 1978, MCL 333.5431 — screening required; religious exemption not statutorily codified as a standalone form but refusal is documented in the medical record.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services — Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: No standalone hearing screening declination form — refusal documented in medical record per MDHHS guidance.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if objection, document refusal in medical record; arrange outpatient follow-up if needed.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services — CCHD Screening
cchd_screening.state_form_note: No standalone CCHD declination form — refusal documented in medical record as part of overall newborn screening refusal.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse ox screening; document refusal in medical record.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form — documented via medical record refusal per MDHHS guidance.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: document refusal in medical record. If administering: apply within 1h of birth.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to Michigan Care Improvement Registry (MCIR).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
